description: Built-in functions and procedures cannot be dropped or altered - by NAMESPACE, not a guard: DROP/ALTER FUNCTION and PROCEDURE resolve schema-scoped objects only, so the refusal is the ordinary does-not-exist naming the fully qualified schema object; IF EXISTS forgives it; a user routine sharing a built-in's name creates and drops freely, the built-in untouched throughout. All live-verified. Converted 1:1 from ddl/BuiltinRoutineImmutabilityTest (now retired).
